prose: Aircad is a browser-based professional 2D drafting and 3D solid modeling tool with multiplayer editing and an AI agent that drafts, models and renders alongside you, driven from a command line with familiar shortcuts or plain words. One shared file is the source of truth, with unlimited version history and attribution per edit.
highlights: 2D drafting and 3D modeling in the browser
AI agent edits and renders in the drawing
Multiplayer: one shared file, no stale copies
Full version history with per-edit attribution
